instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched OpenStudio Application graphical user interface. Do not open Terminal or a shell; do not run Ruby, Python, OpenStudio CLI, EnergyPlus command-line tools, shell commands, or helper scripts; do not edit OSM, OSW, SQL, ERR, or other deliverable files directly outside the GUI. Use only OpenStudio Application GUI tools, dialogs, and built-in save/run commands. Add Missing Windows. Work in the opened OpenStudio application, starting from the Desktop input file init.osm. Modify the model rather than replacing the task package with an unrelated file. Save result.osm in the task output folder. Starting from init.osm, add three exterior FixedWindow subsurfaces to the existing WindowOffice space while keeping the space and thermal zone links intact. The completed model must contain 1 building story, 1 spaces and 1 thermal zones. Use these exact OS:Space names: WindowOffice. Every space must be assigned to a building story and a thermal zone, and each space must have more than 0.05 m2 of floor area. Model the enclosure with 6 OS:Surface objects, split into 1 floor surfaces, 1 roof/ceiling surfaces and 4 wall surfaces. The surface outside-boundary counts should be 1 Ground, 5 Outdoors and 0 Surface. Add 3 OS:SubSurface objects, all FixedWindow windows, with total fixed-window area 7.20 m2 within +/-0.75 m2. Include 0 ideal-loads air systems, 1 zone HVAC equipment lists and 0 dual-setpoint thermostats. Set the geometry so the overall surface-geometry bounding box spans 12.00 m in X, 6.00 m in Y and 3.20 m in Z, each within +/-0.10 m. The total floor surface area should be 72.00 m2 within +/-0.75 m2 and the total exterior wall gross area should be 115.20 m2 within +/-0.75 m2. Other model details may vary as long as the saved OSM satisfies these stated requirements.
